summary: Cboe Global Markets entered into a $400 million five-year revolving credit facility, replacing a prior agreement, with an accordion feature up to $600 million. The facility is a routine refinancing of corporate debt, not a special situation event. Interest rates are based on Term SOFR (or other benchmarks) plus a margin tied to public debt ratings. The credit agreement supports general corporate purposes, with no acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign involved. As this is a standard credit facility amendment, it falls outside the special-situations categories.
